courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 水庫排砂隧道
related.transfer: 可遷移「水壓高度與接縫」與「狹縫層流與敏感度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水庫排砂隧道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Head pressure and joints" and "Slot flow and sensitivity" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以接縫變形材料接續與澆置品質形成連續止水；水庫排砂隧道則以以分流輸砂磨耗與下游銜接驗證排砂隧道為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on forming continuous water barriers through joint movement splicing and placement quality; Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels centres on verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水壓高度與接縫」與「分流比與庫區水量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水庫排砂隧道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「底板磨耗與厚度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Head pressure and joints” and “Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Invert abrasion and thickness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大壩止水帶施工
history.text: 本課所研究的以接縫變形材料接續與澆置品質形成連續止水，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。數值均為材料幾何與水量盤點，不能替代止水帶產品試驗、接縫設計與壓力驗證。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on forming continuous water barriers through joint movement splicing and placement quality reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Numbers describe geometry and water accounting, not substitutes for product testing joint design and pressure verification. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
